Scene / Preset Tools - V1.34
  These are performance shortcuts built from the validated four-lane system.
  They do not introduce new parameter ranges; they call the existing safe global layer.

Scene commands:
  SCN = show this scene / preset menu
  S0  = Home / Clean anchors
  S1  = Rolling scene
  S1A = Rolling Light
  S1B = Rolling Push
  S2  = Deeper scene
  S2A = Deeper Groove
  S2B = Deeper Pressure
  S3  = Intense scene
  S3A = Intense Motion
  S3B = Intense Grit
  S4  = Wild scene
  S4A = Wild Controlled
  S4B = Wild Maximum
  S5  = Back to Clean anchors

Scene behavior:
  SCN only displays this menu/status; it does not send MIDI or load anchors.
  S0 loads the full four-pad anchor state if needed, or returns all pads to anchors if already loaded.
  S1-S4 and S1A-S4B now auto-load the four-pad anchors first if needed, then run the scene.
  S5 returns all four pads to the validated anchors.
